boot: Use case: game-key-art concept illustration, PREVIEW ONLY for FirepowerLoop boot loading screen. Create one premium 16:9 landscape promotional concept painting, NOT a gameplay screenshot, NOT a 3D model turntable, NOT a UI screenshot. References: image 1 is ONLY the real game's protagonist identity/outfit/rifle reference: olive green military helmet, simple pale beige long sleeve shirt, dark gray trousers, ordinary civilian military-survivor silhouette; ignore coins and skull props in that reference. Image 2 is ONLY an example of polished faceted low-poly game-poster illustration and cinematic staging; do NOT copy its golems, temple statue, medieval enemies or its composition. Art direction: stylized painterly low-poly concept art with expressive angular planes, rich atmospheric perspective and cinematic light, more finished and evocative than literal Unity geometry. CAMERA AT HUMAN EYE LEVEL or slightly below, horizon visible, absolutely no bird's-eye/isometric/tactical map view. A single recognizable protagonist is on the RIGHT half, cropped between lower chest and waist by the image bottom: head, shoulders, arms and AK-style rifle, no legs or feet visible, not a tiny full-body person pasted onto a map. Three-quarter shoulder/back view aiming diagonally into a tense coastal harbor scene. Scene suggests the current arcade zombie game: weathered timber dock, a few cargo crates, sea mist, dark cliffs, a handful of readable infected civilian silhouettes emerging in distant haze; warm orange muzzle glow and sparks against deep ocean teal and cool dawn haze. The protagonist should feel physically integrated into the painting, with matching rim light and atmospheric shadows. Reserve roughly LEFT 38% as elegant dark low-detail ocean haze/sky/cliff shadow for a large game title and a bottom-left progress/status area; natural soft transition, no hard rectangle panel. Keep most action and strongest contrasts in right 60%, with excellent visual hierarchy. No gore. No invented giant monsters, medieval weapons, sci-fi armor, base-building or vehicles. No text, no letters, no logo, no menu buttons, no HUD, no progress bar, no watermarks. Deliver a complete polished concept illustration filling the frame edge-to-edge.
start: Use case: game-key-art concept illustration, PREVIEW ONLY for FirepowerLoop start menu. Create one premium 16:9 landscape illustrated game poster, NOT a screenshot, NOT a literal rendering of an empty arena. References: image 1 is ONLY the actual protagonist identity/outfit/weapon reference (olive green helmet, pale beige long sleeve shirt, dark gray trousers, AK-style gun); ignore the coin and skull props. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for polished faceted low-poly illustration quality and energetic arcade action; do not copy its giant golems, medieval hooded enemies, temple statue, or existing composition. SAME FAMILY as a cinematic FirepowerLoop coastal boot key art: painterly faceted polygonal forms, vibrant sea teal with warm amber muzzle flashes, layered atmosphere, clear strong silhouettes, professional illustrated marketing key art. Eye-level to slightly low camera, no top-down, no isometric view. Main hero prominently on LEFT 45% in a close waist-up / chest-up three-quarter front action portrait, helmet shadow partly obscures face, feet and lower body OUT OF FRAME. He is braced firing the recognizably AK-style rifle into the middle-distance to the center-right, muzzle flash strongly designed but not hiding silhouette. Behind him in the MIDDLE distance are infected civilians in torn everyday clothing pushing between dock crates and a harbor shed, distant rocky coast and ocean haze; one small white-and-yellow four-rotor support drone in the midground, a game feature rather than huge central robot. Convey arcade firepower and a real illustrated world, not a collage of 3D cut-outs; illustration should have designed depth, action diagonals, reflected warm lighting and atmospheric separation. Rightmost 34% naturally falls into dark teal smoke / cliff shade with low detail, reserved for game title and a vertical menu; NO hard rectangular panel drawn. Do not paint any important character behind the menu safe area. No gore, no giant monsters or medieval combatants, no literal arena boundaries, no grass tile grid, no floating terrain diorama, no photorealism, no new buildings implying base management. No text, no letters, no logos, no menu buttons, no HUD, no progress indicator, no watermark. Edge-to-edge finished concept art.
